rationale: GEMM 2048x2048x2048 float16 with fp32 accumulation; all candidate block dimensions (64/128 for M and N, 32/64 for K) divide M=N=K=2048, so the full domain subset is supported by the first kernel family. threads is fixed to 128 per allowed values. shared_memory_limit=49152 permits larger tiles/stages (e.g., 128x128 blocks up to a few stages) while maintaining a conservative development bound; the analytic footprint cap informs selection among feasible tuples. Weights are positive and finite within [0.001,100], favoring traffic reduction primarily, with moderate penalization of pipeline underutilization and footprint, and lighter emphasis on launch overhead since 2048x2048 offers ample work. This formulation is purely analytic MIP-based selection and does not imply measured GPU performance: CPU-shadow correctness or latency would not establish CUDA correctness or GB10 performance, timings cannot be inferred without SASS, and no checked GPU results are claimed.
